clusters.association: Transfer-financing rules expanded broker funding for margin finance; unlike a mere authorization event, the system showed rapid actual borrowing and margin-balance growth within ten trading days. Map brokers with already-material margin-financing income/share.

The QFII ceiling was raised sharply, but quota authorization did not mechanically equal immediate capital deployment or company earnings. Treat early price reaction as a negative control until actual quota usage/flow becomes material.
Rate cuts and easier liquidity affect many sectors with offsetting incidence; without a direct realized quantity and quantified company sensitivity, this is not a market-structure selection.

guardrails: V2 definition is unchanged from preregistration.
No 2013 company results or later price outcomes are used before freeze.
Price momentum itself is not system-flow evidence.
QFII authorization is not treated as realized usage.
